question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Fit as a fiddle

options.text: To ignore what someone is saying

solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. **"In good health".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fit as a fiddle:** To be in very good physical condition.(बहुत अच्छी शारीरिक स्थिति में होना)

 
 
• **Example:** After weeks of exercise and dieting, he is now fit as a fiddle.
 
 
 
• **In good health: **(अच्छे स्वास्थ्य में) - Being well in body and mind.
 
• Hence, it can be said that Fit as a fiddle means in good health.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"In good health".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **At the last moment: **(अंतिम क्षण में)
 
• **To ignore what someone is saying: **(किसी की बात को अनदेखा करना)d.
 
• **To betray a close person:** (एक करीबी व्यक्ति को धोखा देना)
